statement: PLATFORM-assisted Merchant creation and full-profile amendments must preserve IAM separation, reviewer independence, protected evidence, and the effective Merchant lifecycle.
scope: PLATFORM-assisted Merchant application for an existing eligible MERCHANT Tenant
protected Merchant image evidence and legal identity numbers
single full-page Merchant create and edit interaction
separate full-page Merchant detail and review interaction with one shared read-only presentation
given: an ACTIVE unbound MERCHANT Tenant or an ACTIVE/DISABLED Merchant
a recently stepped-up PLATFORM Session holding one exact protected permission
the accepted ADR-0015 and exact section 12 API contract
when: a protected PLATFORM operator submits a Merchant application or amendment
another protected PLATFORM operator reviews the pending version
a protected image is uploaded, attached, previewed or superseded
then: GET /api/platform/merchant-onboarding/eligible-tenants and POST /api/platform/merchants require merchant:create and may bind only an existing ACTIVE unbound MERCHANT Tenant without creating IAM records.

POST /api/platform/merchants/{merchantId}/amendments requires merchant:amend; GET /api/platform/merchants/{merchantId}/amendments/pending requires merchant:view; review-decisions requires merchant:review.
Temporary document commands require merchant:document:upload, attached document reads require merchant:document:view, and no document endpoint returns a public URL or original bytes.

The existing attached-document endpoint accepts optional amendmentId: omission reads the current effective binding, presence reads only the exact pending amendment attachment, and a pending review never falls back to current evidence.
Create and amendment accept the exact 23 required profile inputs, reject JSON null and unknown fields, and allow only remarks to be empty; receiveEmail is excluded.
The initial industryCode values are FINANCIAL_SERVICES, ECOMMERCE, RETAIL, TRAVEL, EDUCATION and OTHER; legalIdTypeCode values are NATIONAL_ID, PASSPORT and DRIVER_LICENSE.
New merchantTypeCode writes and responses use PLATFORM, INDIRECT, COMMISSION or SALES; DIRECT is replay-only and PLATFORM is canonical.
A create records the author Membership and creates Merchant PENDING_REVIEW; the same Membership cannot review that application.

An amendment has independent PENDING_REVIEW, APPROVED, REJECTED or STALE status plus immutable originMerchantVersion, originStatus and authorMembershipId; submission leaves the effective Merchant unchanged.

Amendment approval proves origin version and status, applies all fields atomically, increments Merchant rowVersion once and preserves ACTIVE or DISABLED; rejection leaves Merchant unchanged and drift makes the amendment STALE.

PNG/JPEG evidence is magic-checked, dimension-bounded, fully decoded and re-encoded before AES-256-GCM private BYTEA storage; temporary uploads are actor/target/kind-bound, expire after 30 minutes and attach once.
legalIdNo uses an independent AEAD key purpose and only legalIdNoMasked is returned; Merchant stores documentId references and content is authorized streaming only.
After MCH-003 cutover PUT /api/platform/merchants/{merchantId}/profile is authorized existing receipt replay-only; a deduplication miss returns 40910 and the UI never calls it.
The PLATFORM UI uses one full-page create/edit form; detail and review use separate hidden routes backed by one complete read-only profile, and review adds one bounded modal action.

PLATFORM tables render every effective action inline when the count is at most three; only the fourth and later actions use the existing click-triggered overflow menu, and Merchant markets are centered localized names without codes.
counterexamples: PLATFORM create provisions a Tenant, User, Membership, Role or Credential.
An amendment writes Merchant fields or status before approval, or the author Membership reviews its own version.
A document is persisted as a URL, filesystem path, object key, original upload, unencrypted BYTEA or browser-visible plaintext.
DIRECT remains selectable for a new write or an MCH-002 deduplication miss performs a legacy profile update.

The frontend submits fewer than 23 fields, uses a drawer, gives detail an active review command, separates review evidence from its decision, shows more than three inline actions or opens overflow on hover.
